scripts.meilisearch:up: docker run -d --name eyeocean-meilisearch -p 7700:7700 -e MEILI_MASTER_KEY="${MEILI_API_KEY:?set MEILI_API_KEY first}" -e MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS=true -v eyeocean_meili_data:/meili_data getmeili/meilisearch:latest
scripts.postgres:up: docker run -d --name eyeocean-postgres -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD first}" -e POSTGRES_DB=eyeocean -v eyeocean_pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16-alpine
